title: Higher direct images as sheafified cohomology presheaves
statement:
Let $p:X\to S$ be any morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and let $F\in\Ab(X_{\Et})$ be an abelian sheaf on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For an object $U$ of $X_{\Et}$ write $H^q(U,F)$ for the $q$-th right derived functor, evaluated at $F$, of the left exact functor $\Ab(X_{\Et})\to\Ab$, $G\mapsto G(U)$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive] (computed from an injective resolution of $F$ in $\Ab(X_{\Et})$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]). For an etale $V\to S$ the base change $X\times_SV\to X$ is etale, hence an object of $X_{\Et}$. Then for every $q\geq0$ the higher direct image $R^qp_*F=\mathcal H^q(Rp_*F)$ of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is canonically isomorphic to the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the presheaf on $S_{\Et}$

$$
 V\longmapsto H^q(X\times_SV,F).
$$

No hypothesis (quasi-compactness, separatedness) is put on $p$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 072W (lemma-higher-direct-images), applied to the morphism of sites $X_{\Et}\to S_{\Et}$ given by the continuous functor $u(V)=X\times_SV$ with $\mathcal O=\underline{\mathbf Z}$ (so that modules are abelian sheaves); the passage from the K-injective definition of $Rp_*$ to an injective resolution is lem-sp-kinjective-computes (2)
